task: prepare a connector for directory review
definition: Work the pre-submission checklist for tool design, prompt-injection safety, assets, privacy policy, and test credentials.
outcome: the server, its assets, privacy policy, and reviewer test credentials satisfy the published review criteria; nothing has been filed yet

records.outcome: the local connector carries the privacy policy disclosures the review requires, so it will not be rejected on that ground; nothing has been filed
steps: Add a "Privacy Policy" section to README.md
Add a privacy_policies array to manifest.json
Point the entries at HTTPS privacy policy URLs
Cover data collection, usage and storage, third-party sharing, retention, and contact information
records.notes: Missing or incomplete privacy policies result in immediate rejection.

records.outcome: carousel screenshots and their paired prompt text meet the directory asset specifications and are ready to attach to an MCP App submission
steps: Capture three to five PNG screenshots at least 1000px wide
Crop each to the app response only, leaving out the prompt
Provide the prompt text separately for each screenshot
Optionally start from the Anthropic MCP Apps Figma community carousel template

evidence.quote: **Crop:** to the app response only—**do not include the prompt** in the image

records.notes: Video and GIF are not accepted; no separate mobile assets are required. Mechanism is 'other' because the text does not say where the screenshots are produced.

records.outcome: the connector has been run against the pre-submission checklist and, for a plugin, validated, before anything is filed
steps: Run the pre-submission checklist from the review criteria page
For plugins, run claude plugin validate

evidence.quote: for plugins, `claude plugin validate` before you submit
